description: Chart 21 — How trips to hospitality venues are actually made. Weighted share of Victorian trips whose destination is a pub/bar, restaurant/cafe, nightclub, club, reception centre or social venue (VISTA destplace2), by main mode (linkmode) recoded into five groups, POOLED across the 2022-23 and 2023-24 VISTA Trips waves (n = 2,378 surveyed trips). Public transport is just ~5% of these trips — private vehicle (66%) and walking/cycling (28%) dominate — even though 78% of venues sit within 400 m of a stop. This is the §4 'one possible reason' the §3 proximity bust holds: being near a stop is the baseline, not the way most people get to a venue. Composition snapshot, NOT a trend; rideshare-growth context lives in the §4 prose (Roy Morgan). Public-transport bar is highlighted in the §4 context navy; the others are neutral grey, outside the reserved metro/regional teal-orange. Data: VISTA, DTP Victoria, CC BY 4.0; derived by scripts/derive_hospitality_modes.py.
